figure1.caption: Unsettled positive signals by independent session. Each dot is the percentage of 30 rounds with a positive highest-buyer-bid index and no executed trade. Horizontal jitter separates ties without changing values; thick marks show group means (0.667% and 8.000%). Each condition contains ten independent sessions. A no-trade positive signal is not a ground-truth collusion false positive.

figure2.caption: Threshold sensitivity of the session-mean contrast (seller communication minus no seller communication). Points show percentage-point differences in the share of rounds with I above the strict threshold and no executed trade. Bars are separate 95% percentile intervals from 20,000 within-condition session bootstrap resamples. The fixed primary threshold is zero; higher thresholds are descriptive secondary checks. Both effect size and evidential strength weaken at higher thresholds. Both conditions contain ten independent sessions, with 30 rounds per session.
